metric.capability_coverage.formula: C = 100 * (sum over 44 probes of capability_points * support_factor) / 88
metric.capability_coverage.na_policy_compliance: No probe was scored N/A for C++; all 44 probes received a fragment and a FULL or PARTIAL support level with cited justification, per NA-6 and the deterministic tie-break rule. No probe was deleted, reworded, or re-weighted.

per_probe.note: const int n = 7; return n; — ISO C++20 const-qualified local, immutable binding.
namespace-scope 'static long long counter = 0;' plus 'constexpr long long LIMIT = 100;' — mutable storage vs compile-time constant, ISO C++20 constexpr.
int v; if(cond) v=5; else v=9; return v; — declaration without initializer, definitely assigned on both paths, well-defined in C++.
unsigned char buf[16]; buf[0]=1; return buf[0]; — genuinely uninitialized array storage (no zero-fill) per ISO C++20 declarator rules.
x += 1; in-place compound assignment.
xs[1] = 42; std::vector operator[] in-place element mutation.

per_probe.note: int& port = slot; port = 9; return slot; — native reference type, writable alias, ISO C++20 [dcl.ref].

per_probe.note: std::span<const int> window(xs); window[0]; — C++20 <span>, non-owning non-copying read-only view.

per_probe.family: 4. aliasing, references, borrowing, addressing, and dereferencing where applicable
per_probe.note: std::shared_ptr<Widget> first = make_shared<Widget>(5); route through a one-element std::vector to obtain 'second'; bool same = first.get()==second.get(); — raw-pointer identity comparison distinct from value equality.

Bare call f(x). Ordinary C++ call-site syntax is fully expressible; the fact that the call site alone does not reveal pass-by-value vs pass-by-reference is a determinacy finding (metric B/D), not a capability gap.
void put(int& cell){ cell = 12; } put(cell); — reference parameter is C++'s standard explicit writable-alias-passing mechanism.
auto neg = [k](int a){ return k - a; }; std::transform(xs.begin(),xs.end(),ys.begin(),neg); — C++11 lambda closure capturing enclosing local, passed by name.
int mid(std::vector<int> xs){ return xs[1]; } auto y = mid(xs); return y; — value return, independent of source aggregate.
std::pair<int,int> divmod2(...) returning {a/b, a%b}; auto [q,r] = divmod2(a,b); — C++17 structured bindings destructure a single multi-result call.
int r = a*b+c; ordinary precedence multiply-add.
int q=a/b; int m=a%b; double d=(double)a/b; — integer division/remainder and explicit real division.

per_probe.family: 8. integer overflow, division-by-zero, and other numeric edge behavior
per_probe.note: No std checked/wrapping/saturating integer op exists under the frozen C++20 recipe (saturation arithmetic is C++26-only, not in <numeric> for C++20; no checked-add returning optional). Only rung (iv), the plain '+' operator, is reachable, and ISO C++20 7.7p4 leaves signed-integer overflow undefined behavior — the specific overflow GUARANTEE the canonical_task names is not documented at all (worse than 'unspecified'), matching P-c (guarantee not documented).

per_probe.family: 8. integer overflow, division-by-zero, and other numeric edge behavior
per_probe.note: int q = (b==0) ? 0 : a/b; — explicit local guard, rung (ii) of the canonical task's own preference order, fully deterministic and standard control flow.
bool eq = (s1 == s2); std::string::operator== compares contents (ISO C++20 [string.cmp]).
std::sort(xs.begin(),xs.end(),std::greater<int>()); bool lt = a<b; — explicit comparator supplied as value from <algorithm>/<functional>.
int32_t small = static_cast<int32_t>(big); — explicit narrowing cast; C++20 (P0907R4) makes out-of-range signed conversion well-defined as reduction modulo 2^N.
double sum = i + d; — implicit usual arithmetic conversions per ISO C++20 [expr.arith.conv].
int e = xs[i]; return e; — ordinary operator[]. Evidence-only .checked variant available via xs.at(i) (throws std::out_of_range); does not affect capability points per spec.
std::span<int> part(xs.data()+1, 3); return part[0]; — C++20 std::span sub-range shares storage, non-copying.
std::optional<int> o = std::nullopt; int n = o.value_or(0); — C++17 <optional> with standard fallback accessor.

std::optional::transform/and_then are C++23-only and unavailable under the frozen C++20 recipe. Per R9 named-substitution exception (F12.P2 is explicitly listed), the explicit conditional form was substituted for the standard optional-aware chaining operation; scored PARTIAL under P-a, never FULL.

per_probe.note: int parse_twice(const std::string& s){ return std::stoi(s) * 2; } — std::stoi throws std::invalid_argument/out_of_range, unhandled, propagates to caller.

per_probe.family: 13. errors, failure values, exceptions, and propagation
per_probe.note: try { n = std::stoi(s); } catch (...) { n = 0; } — local recovery via catch block.

per_probe.family: 14. alternatives / sum / variant types and dispatch over alternatives
per_probe.note: using Shape = std::variant<Circle, Rect>; Shape s = Circle{2.0}; — std::variant's alternative set is fixed by its template arguments at the type's own declaration and cannot be extended from elsewhere (C++17 <variant>); a genuinely closed sum type, not a substitution.

per_probe.family: 14. alternatives / sum / variant types and dispatch over alternatives
per_probe.note: std::visit with the standard 'overloaded' lambda-set idiom (class template argument deduction + using-declaration pack, core language only) over the Shape variant, no default arm — overload resolution fails to compile unless every alternative is covered, giving compile-time exhaustiveness.

per_probe.family: 14. alternatives / sum / variant types and dispatch over alternatives
per_probe.note: Abstract base 'Shape' with virtual area(); Circle/Rect implemented in unit shapes; Tri implemented in a separate unit under the frozen multi_unit_recipe (clang++ -std=c++20 -O2 util.cpp FILE.cpp -o BIN); dispatch through a base reference/pointer.
template<typename T> T head(const std::vector<T>& xs){ return xs[0]; } — declared result type is exactly T, not type-erased, reused at int and std::string.
template<std::totally_ordered T> T max_of(T a, T b){ return a>b?a:b; } — C++20 <concepts> declaration-site constraint using std::totally_ordered.
std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Named>> items holding an A and a B; items[0]->tag() dispatches virtually at runtime through the abstract Named element type.
std::vector<int> xs{1,2,3}; int total = std::accumulate(xs.begin(), xs.end(), 0); — <numeric> standard sum/fold.
std::unordered_map<std::string,int> mp{{"a",1}}; range-for entry iteration to sum values; lookup miss via mp.find("b")==mp.end() ? 0 : it->second.

per_probe.family: 17. resource management, ownership, lifetime, destruction, or equivalent cleanup semantics
per_probe.note: std::ifstream f("data.txt"); RAII destructor closes the handle at scope exit on every path, including exception unwinding when f.exceptions(std::ios::failbit) is enabled to surface the open/read failure.

per_probe.family: 17. resource management, ownership, lifetime, destruction, or equivalent cleanup semantics
per_probe.note: struct Handle { int id; ~Handle(){ released++; } }; — destructor runs deterministically exactly once at end of scope, ISO C++20 [class.dtor].
#include <iostream>; std::cout << "x" << "\n"; — standard include introduces std::cout into scope.

namespace util { int pub_add(int,int); } declared in util.h; secret() given internal (translation-unit-local) linkage inside util.cpp so it cannot be referenced from FILE.cpp; call site util::pub_add(2,3); built under the frozen multi_unit_recipe.

per_probe.family: 19. concurrency / asynchronous execution where the language supports it
per_probe.note: auto f1=std::async(std::launch::async,[](){return 20;}); auto f2=std::async(std::launch::async,[](){return 22;}); int sum=f1.get()+f2.get(); — <future> standard concurrency facility.

per_probe.family: 19. concurrency / asynchronous execution where the language supports it
per_probe.note: std::atomic<int64_t> counter{0}; two std::thread each calling counter.fetch_add(1) 1000 times, joined; ISO C++20 clause 31 (atomics) normatively documents atomic read-modify-write as race-free; final value 2000 verified across 20 runs.
#include <cstdlib>; std::abs(-3); — <cstdlib> declares the C library abs() with C linkage, reachable via C++'s built-in C interop with no separate binding generator.

extern "C" int add2(int a, int b){ return a+b; } — extern "C" linkage specification (built-in mechanism) yields an unmangled, C-ABI-callable symbol; verified with nm on the produced binary (V2 validator exercised on known-positive/known-negative cases).

toolchain_recipe_used.note: C++ has no checked arithmetic/bounds mode; per toolchain_binding.safety_mode_clause this absence is a recorded language fact scored by metrics B/D, not a recipe deviation.
